policies.label: Public domain — verified
policies.description: Local storage is allowed only after the specific source/edition or recording is verified to be in the public domain for the applicable use.

policies.label: Open license
policies.description: Local storage is allowed only when the exact asset license permits it and attribution/license evidence is preserved.

policies.label: Permission granted
policies.description: Local storage is allowed only with preserved permission evidence covering the exact asset and intended use.

policies.label: Metadata only
policies.description: Bibliographic metadata may be stored, but no protected full text, audio, video or image bytes are ingested.

policies.label: External link only
policies.description: The project may preserve metadata and a verified external URL, but must not copy the asset locally.

policies.label: Copyright restricted
policies.description: Protected asset. Keep only permitted metadata/provenance; local content ingestion is forbidden without a later rights change.

policies.label: Rights review required
policies.description: Rights are unresolved. No full text or media bytes may enter canonical storage until evidence is reviewed.
